# Polarkast

> Polarkast is a game studio. Operators (casinos) integrate through a seamless-wallet API: Polarkast calls five endpoints on the operator's server to move money, and the operator calls Polarkast to launch a game and to look a round up.
> The API spec `openapi.yaml` is authoritative; if any page disagrees with it, the spec wins.

## Read in this order

- [index.md](index.md): the integration in five steps and what stays with humans.
- [wallet.md](wallet.md): the five wallet endpoints, what each does with the money, which errors to return.
- [signing.md](signing.md): signing and verifying `X-Signature`.
- [idempotency.md](idempotency.md): transaction ids, duplicates, rollbacks (unknown and late bets), retries from Polarkast.
- [errors.md](errors.md): the closed list of error codes and when to return each.
- [conformance.md](conformance.md): the conformance CLI; run it until it passes.
- [launch.md](launch.md): calling `POST /v1/launch`.
- [catalog.md](catalog.md): calling `GET /v1/games`: the game catalog for your operator, with RTP per mode, stakes and play amounts.
- [rounds.md](rounds.md): calling `POST /v1/round`: a round's transactions with their status, and a short-lived round page.
- [freebets.md](freebets.md): free rounds: create a reward, what the player and your wallet see (a win with `reward_id`, no bet), cancel, expiry.
- [sandbox.md](sandbox.md): the hosted sandbox: credentials and wallet registration, expose your wallet, launch, play a forced win and loss, then 4 Star Dragons.
- [four-star-dragons.md](four-star-dragons.md): the game 4 Star Dragons: what your wallet sees, play amounts, bought rounds, fun mode.
- [nova-forge.md](nova-forge.md): the game Nova Forge: what your wallet sees, play amounts, the ante, bought rounds, fun mode.
- [openapi.yaml](openapi.yaml): the spec. Consult it for every field, range and status.
- [skills/integrate/SKILL.md](skills/integrate/SKILL.md): the same procedure as a skill.

## Ignore

- `integration-prompt.md`: for humans, not needed to integrate.
- Anything not linked above.

## Stop and ask a human

Commercial agreement, production credentials, compliance approval, go-live sign-off.
